description: Phase 2: Companies & Jobs. Implement full Company CRUD (admin, forms, views, templates), Category and Skill models, Job model with full-text search using django.contrib.postgres.search, Employee model for company staff CRUD, public job listing page with django-filter (filter by category/skill/location/job_type), job detail page, and JOB_MODERATION_ENABLED setting integration for approval workflow.
steps: 1. Add Company admin with all fields, list_display, list_filter, search_fields, and actions for approve/reject/suspend. File: companies/admin.py
2. Create CompanyForm and CompanyUpdateForm in companies/forms.py following the pattern in accounts/forms.py with Bootstrap styling. Include logo upload, industry/size choices, about textarea.

3. Create Company CRUD views in companies/views.py: CompanyCreateView (only for EMPLOYEE role users without existing company), CompanyUpdateView (owner only), CompanyDetailView (public), CompanyListView (public, verified companies). Use LoginRequiredMixin and permission checks.
4. Create URL patterns in companies/urls.py with app_name='companies': create/, <slug>/, <slug>/edit/, list/

5. Create templates in templates/companies/: company_form.html (create/edit with crispy forms), company_detail.html (show logo, about, jobs list), company_list.html (grid/list of verified companies with search)
6. Create Category model in jobs/models.py with name and slug fields. Create Skill model with name field. Add indexes and __str__ methods.

7. Create Job model in jobs/models.py with FK to Company, title, slug, description, category FK, skills M2M, location, job_type choices (FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, CONTRACT, INTERNSHIP), salary_min, salary_max, deadline, is_active, is_approved (for moderation), posted_at, expires_at. Add full-text search fields using SearchVectorField from django.contrib.postgres.search for title+description. Include indexes on category, location, job_type, is_active, is_approved.

8. Create Employee model in companies/models.py with FK to User, FK to Company, position field, is_primary boolean, created_at. User can be employee of multiple companies. Add unique_together constraint on (user, company).
9. Create Job admin with list_display, list_filter (category, job_type, is_active, is_approved), search_fields, actions for approve/reject. File: jobs/admin.py

10. Create JobForm and JobFilterSet in jobs/forms.py. JobForm with all fields, Bootstrap styling, skill multi-select. JobFilterSet using django_filters with filters for category, skills, location (CharFilter with icontains), job_type (MultipleChoiceFilter).

11. Create Job CRUD views in jobs/views.py: JobCreateView (EMPLOYEE only, checks user has company), JobUpdateView (company owner/employees only), JobDetailView (public), JobListView (public with django_filters, only active+approved jobs, or active+pending if moderation disabled), MyJobsListView (employee's company jobs).
12. Create Employee CRUD views in companies/views.py: EmployeeCreateView (add employee to company), EmployeeListView (company owner only), EmployeeDeleteView (remove employee).
13. Create URL patterns in jobs/urls.py with app_name='jobs': '', 'create/', '<slug>/', '<slug>/edit/', 'my-jobs/'

14. Create templates in templates/jobs/: job_list.html (with django_filters form, job cards with category/location/salary), job_detail.html (full description, apply button if user is job seeker, edit button if owner), job_form.html (crispy form), my_jobs.html (company's jobs with edit/delete actions)
15. Create templates in templates/companies/: employee_list.html (company employees with add/remove), employee_form.html (add employee by email)
16. Update config/urls.py to include companies.urls and jobs.urls
17. Run makemigrations for companies and jobs apps
19. Create seed data: 3 categories (Technology, Healthcare, Finance), 10 skills (Python, Django, React, etc.), 2 sample companies (1 verified, 1 pending), 5 sample jobs with varied filters
acceptance_criteria: Company model has migrations and admin configured with approve/reject actions
EMPLOYEE role users can create company profile (one per user) with logo upload
Company owners can update their company profile and manage employees
Public users can view verified company list and detail pages
Category, Skill, and Employee models created with proper relationships
Job model supports full-text search on title and description with SearchVector
Job admin includes approve/reject actions visible when JOB_MODERATION_ENABLED=True
EMPLOYEE users with company can create/edit jobs with category, skills, location, job_type filters
Public job listing page shows active jobs (approved if moderation enabled) with django-filter for category, skills, location, job_type
Job detail page shows full description, company info, and apply button for job seekers
All templates use Bootstrap 5.3 + Bootstrap Icons styling
All forms use crispy_forms with crispy_bootstrap5
verification: Create superuser and test in admin: approve/reject company, approve/reject job
Register as EMPLOYEE, create company, add job with category/skills
View job list page, test filters by category, skill, location, job_type
Verify full-text search on jobs works
findings: All features implemented successfully. SearchVectorField added to Job model for full-text search (note: full-text search updates via triggers/signals would need to be implemented in a later phase for production use). All templates use Bootstrap 5.3 with Bootstrap Icons. All forms use crispy_forms with crispy_bootstrap5. Seed data created with 3 categories, 10 skills, 2 companies (1 verified, 1 pending), and 5 jobs with varied types and filters. Employee model allows users to work for multiple companies. JOB_MODERATION_ENABLED setting properly integrated - jobs auto-approve when disabled.
